entry_points.text: Unlink removes name relative to dir descriptor with write hold and stale retry; VFS deletes non-dir after checks.
Open converts user path or normalizes kernel name; getcwd samples renders and copies; early init prepares coredump and DAX table.
Submount walks under guard; reclaim drains LRU; cursors allocate anonymous; early setup creates caches and derives max files.
Boot builds mounts, registers tree and sets init root; early prep inits guards supers kernfs dio and root; lookup returns stable inode.
Eventfd and epoll creation validate; control dispatches add modify delete; wait variants normalize timeout then share helper.
Epoll files handle release poll ioctls; release wakes and detaches; DAX serves trunc writeback faults and unshare.

exports.text: Parent lookup yields parent plus final with retry; dirop holds lock; mountpoint scans; open masks and derives access; unlink auths and deletes.
Core checks eligibility, escalates creds, rendezvouses threads then dumps to file pipe or socket; paths render backward; snapshot records bounds and refs.
DAX handles IO and faults by order, zeroes ranges, inserts and writebacks entries with shared validation.
Dcache obtains aliases, splices and binds inodes, moves entries under exclusion and labels tmpfiles with derived flags.
Kernfs manages root and nodes; direct IO maps submits and completes; eventfd signals; epoll controls and harvests.

hazards.text: Bad identity overflows; empty pipe reports disabled; privileged pattern warns; getcwd fails on alloc unlinked or size.
Conflicts revalidate after wait; long walks reschedule; unexpected states warn once; COW faults surface IO or bus errors.
Boot failures are fatal; ref and drain misuse warns; waits may sleep; eventfd counter saturates needing drain.
Dio faults defer; zero can mask errors; chunks and cursors are asserted; standard errors cover ISDIR NOTDIR NOENT PERM BUSY and stale.
Detach races close via pinning; teardown unlinks tolerantly; insert rolls back on failure; wakeup waits readers; nesting limited to four.

invariants.text: Unlink needs normal name, liveness, rights, protections, sticky and dir checks; open rejects unknown bits and bad combos; access maps to read write.
Dump needs formatter and dumpable state; pipe limits recursion and concurrency; socket needs absolute bounded path; getcwd annotates unreachable.
Acquire prefers unlocked, locks or installs with retry; holes read as zero; order zero is page else huge; compare steps overlap with hole rules.
Remap needs aligned starts, no wrap, limits and no overlap; dedupe compares pairs; cmtime skips when flagged; pressure 100 with sysctls; unalias needs mutex.
Identity pairs high with cyclic low; new node is single-ref biased with held parent; setattr touches masked fields; walk is postorder with rev bump.
Direct count brackets IO with forced sync for sync writes; status prefers progress; drop mask selects pagecache slab; eventfd poll queues then samples.
Eventfd moves eight bytes with sleep; creation checks flags and quota; tree orders by file then fd; ready by link; loop checks reject cycles and depth.

locks.text: Unlink holds target lock; mountpoint holds shared namespace; dentry path uses RCU with retry; tree lock guards DAX.
DAX holds read lock; remap waits DIO and writes back; folio pairs lock by index; name snapshots copy under RCU with retry.
Alias search holds inode lock; LRU isolates under locks; move holds rename exclusion; root and pwd writers use exclusive sequence guard.
Shape needs hierarchy guard, removal also superblock; drain drops guards to wait; inode waits use spin then sleep.
Dio uses dedicated spin; super walk pins next; eventfd and epoll guard queues with spin; mutex serializes epoll tree and scans.

state_machines.text: Unlink resolves, holds mount, auths, removes with delegation and stale retry; open normalizes and scopes; core selects dest then dumps.
Index moves absent to locked to present to dirty to detached; break scans and waits then deletes; faults validate, acquire and map errors.
Shrink moves dead to dispose; discovery waits for new, rewaits freeing, reports stale creating and discards unhashed with retry.
Nodes activate once from biased; removal flags drains and unlinks; dio counts refs, wakes waiter and completes inline or via work.
Scan batches ready and chains arrivals then drains; wait checks, transfers and sleeps; send delivers, disarms one-shot and requeues level.

structs.text: Open uses user and kernel descriptors; snapshot holds bounds and refs; DAX wait pairs cache with start; temp buffers PATH_MAX with core controls.
Wait table twelve bits; low four bits are flags; huge colour from PMD ratio; dentry counts use six slots; empty slash dotdot are 0 1 2.
Root bundles id, guards and top node; node bundles identity, counters, linkage, name and attrs; dio holds geometry with 64 pages.
Epoll context holds mutex, queues, ready, tree and refs; interest carries ready, key and record; dentries link with inline or external names.
